The updates in `KeepWordFilter.java` ensure that the token processing is optimized by correctly managing token retrieval. The addition of tests in `TestUtils.java` serves to validate the changes made in the filter factories, ensuring that the new implementations work as intended and maintain the expected functionality. 

Overall, these modifications reflect a concerted effort to improve the performance of the stopword and keep word filtering mechanisms in the Solr analysis framework.
